description: The line chart presents an ablation study on the HateXplain dataset, comparing the performance of different model variants of MS-FSLHate in terms of precision, recall, and F1-score. The x-axis represents the model variants, which include "Full model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," "w/o Attention," and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The y-axis measures the metric percentage, ranging from approximately 56% to 66%. The precision line is marked with circles and a solid line, starting at 65.78% for the full model and ending at 65.44% for the "w/o Prompt & Augmentation" variant. The recall line is also marked with circles and a solid line, beginning at 65.78% and decreasing to 56.82% by the end of the variants. The F1-score line, similarly marked with circles and a solid line, starts at 65.78% and ends at 57.74%. The chart includes annotations of the metric values at each data point, providing a clear and precise reference for the performance of each model variant.
